lessons.title: Introduction to Computers
lessons.text: Learn what a computer is and what its main parts do: processor, memory, storage, screen and keyboard.
goals: Name the main computer components
Explain what each part does

lessons.title: Windows Basics, Files and Folders
lessons.text: Find your way around Windows, organize files into folders, and save time with keyboard shortcuts.
goals: Create, rename and move files and folders
Use five common keyboard shortcuts

lessons.title: Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint
lessons.text: Get started with the three most used office programs for documents, spreadsheets and presentations.
goals: Write and format a simple document
Enter data and a formula in Excel

lessons.title: Internet Browsing and Email
lessons.text: Search the web properly, understand websites, and send and organize email.
goals: Search effectively and spot reliable sites
Send an email with an attachment

lessons.title: Basic Programming and Digital Skills
lessons.text: Meet the ideas behind programming and the digital skills that help in school, work and business.
goals: Explain what code and an algorithm are
Pick a first language to learn

lessons.title: Online Safety Basics
lessons.text: Protect yourself online by understanding common threats and building safe habits.
goals: Recognize risky links and messages
Know what personal information to keep private

lessons.title: Passwords, Phishing and Account Security
lessons.text: Create strong passwords, turn on two-step verification, and learn how phishing tricks people.
goals: Build a strong, unique password
Spot the signs of a phishing message

lessons.title: The Forex Market and Currency Pairs
lessons.text: Understand what the forex market is, who trades in it, and how currency pairs are quoted.
goals: Explain base and quote currency
Read a currency pair price

lessons.title: Pips, Spreads, Lots, Leverage and Sessions
lessons.text: Learn the key trading terms and when the major market sessions are open.
goals: Define pip, spread, lot and leverage
Explain why leverage increases risk

lessons.title: Candlesticks and Market Structure
lessons.text: Read candlesticks and see how highs and lows show whether price is trending or ranging.
goals: Read open, close, high and low on a candle
Tell an uptrend from a downtrend

lessons.title: Identifying Support and Resistance Zones
lessons.text: Find the areas where price has repeatedly stopped or turned around.
goals: Define support and resistance
Mark zones on a chart

lessons.title: Drawing Support and Resistance Correctly
lessons.text: Draw clean levels as zones, not single lines, and avoid the most common mistakes.
goals: Choose the right timeframe
Draw zones that match the price reaction

lessons.title: Breakouts, Retests and Confirmation
lessons.text: Learn how price breaks a level, comes back to test it, and how to wait for confirmation.
goals: Tell a real breakout from a fake one
Explain what a retest is

lessons.title: Stop-Loss Placement and Risk Management
lessons.text: Protect your account by deciding in advance how much you can lose on each trade.
goals: Place a stop-loss beyond a key level
Limit risk to a small share of the account

lessons.title: Practicing on Charts and Demo Accounts
lessons.text: Test strategies on historical charts or a demo account before risking real money.
goals: Set up a demo account
Keep a simple trading journal
